payload.rebuttal: fixed: Added the missing witness: test_a_deletion_mutant_with_an_empty_replace_also_restores constructs a Mutant with replace="" (the schema default), applies it, and asserts apply_mutant then restore_mutant leaves the file byte-identical to the original. I also added test_restoring_when_replace_recurs_elsewhere_in_the_file, covering the related case the old search-based restore would have gotten wrong even for a non-empty replace (ambiguous restore when replace's bytes already occur elsewhere in the file) — both now pass against the corrected offset-based implementation and would have failed against the code this critique reviewed.
